title: Specialist DevOps Engineer
description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a Specialist DevOps Engineer to join a distributed team, working day-to-day alongside fellow engineers to deliver and maintain reliable, scalable infrastructure. In this role, you will be a strong hands-on practitioner — deploying and operating Kubernetes-based platforms, building CI/CD pipelines, and contributing to the team's shared tooling and practices. You will work collaboratively within established patterns and under the guidance of principal-level engineers, helping the team execute consistently and continuously improve.

**A Day In The Life**
---------------------

**Kubernetes & Container Platform**

* Deploy, operate, and maintain Kubernetes workloads on Redhat Openshift and AKS in production and test environments.
* Work within established cluster standards — applying RBAC policies, namespace conventions, and workload placement guidelines set by the team.
* Implement GitOps workflows using ArgoCD and work with the Kubernetes tooling ecosystem: Helm, Kustomize, ingress controllers, and service mesh.
* Follow and help maintain container image standards: base-image usage, vulnerability scanning, and registry hygiene.

**CI/CD, IaC, & Cloud Platform**

* Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines to support consistent and reliable software delivery.
* Write and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform, following shared module patterns and team standards.
* Support Azure platform operations including networking, IAM, and Azure-native services within defined team practices.

**Observability, Reliability, & Security**

* Instrument monitoring services using the team's observability stack (metrics, logging, tracing, alerting); respond to and investigate incidents.
* Contribute to post-mortems and help implement follow-up improvements to increase system reliability.
* Apply security practices across day-to-day work: secrets management, network policies, and policy enforcement tooling.

**Collaboration & Team Contribution**

* Work closely with fellow engineers and principal-level team members, proactively communicating progress, surfacing blockers, and contributing to shared solutions.
* Maintain and improve team documentation, runbooks, and operational guides to support consistent practices.
* Participate in code and infrastructure reviews, providing constructive feedback and applying guidance received

**What will help you thrive in this role?**
-------------------------------------------

* BTech/MTech/MCA
* 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering.
* Solid Kubernetes experience in production environments; familiarity with Redhat Openshift or AKS.
* Working proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure as code and ArgoCD for GitOps-based deployments.
* Practical experience with Azure services: networking, identity, and cloud-native tooling.
* Experience with CI/CD platforms and the software delivery lifecycle.
* Familiarity with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) and security fundamentals.
* Clear communicator who works well in a team environment and takes direction effectively.
* Experience migrating workloads to Kubernetes or working with on-premises Kubernetes deployments.
* Familiarity with containerization strategies and best practices for legacy application modernization.
* AWS experience or exposure to multi-cloud environments.
* Kubernetes certifications (CKA or CKAD).

  

**Hubbell Incorporated**

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently.

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses.

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.

**Hubbell Utility Solutions**

Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications. HUS provides the critical components that allow the grid to reliably transmit and distribute energy, as well as the communications and controls technologies to make the grid smarter and more flexible.

Hubbell Incorporated, its subsidiaries and affiliates, is an EO Employer AA: M/F/Veteran/Disability. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other protected class.

The above summary of position responsibilities and requirements is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an exhaustive list of duties, skills, efforts, physical requirements, or working conditions associated with the position. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of those principal position elements essential for making decisions related to position performance, employee development, and compensation.

title: Lead DevOps Platform Engineer
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**Lead DevOps Platform Engineer**

**THE ROLE:**

We are seeking a hands-on Platform Engineer to build and operate the infrastructure foundations that enable engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure products. This role will shape the internal developer platform across Kubernetes, observability, AI-enabled workloads, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.

You will work closely with software, DevOps, security, and AI/ML teams to turn platform capabilities into a simple and dependable developer experience. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between architecture decisions, production operations, automation, and practical enablement of partner teams.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Design, build, and operate scalable Kubernetes-based platform capabilities for development, test, and production workloads.
* Create reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, patterns, and automated workflows using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, Kustomize, or equivalent technologies.
* Develop and evolve platform observability: metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, service-level objectives, and operational runbooks.
* Improve platform reliability, capacity management, security posture, and cost efficiency through automation and data-driven operational practices.
* Build the infrastructure required to deploy, operate, observe, and govern AI/ML workloads, including model-serving, GPU-enabled compute, data-access, and workload-isolation patterns where applicable.
* Enable self-service for product and engineering teams through well-designed platform APIs, templates, documentation, golden paths, and CI/CD integrations.
* Partner with application, security, infrastructure, and AI teams to define platform standards and remove delivery bottlenecks.
* Investigate complex production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable preventative improvements.
* Contribute to technical roadmaps, architecture reviews, and engineering standards for the platform.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience designing internal developer platforms or large-scale shared infrastructure.
* Experience with Prometheus, Python, Bash, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Tempo, Elastic, Datadog, Splunk, or comparable observability systems.
* Experience with IBM LSF and Netapp Storage
* Experience with GitOps operating models.
* Experience supporting AI/ML infrastructure, model serving, GPU scheduling, Kubernetes operators, or AI workload orchestration.
* Knowledge of platform security practices, including identity and access management, secrets management, policy enforcement, image security, and supply-chain security.
* Experience with service mesh, API gateways, ingress, networking, or multi-cluster Kubernetes architectures.
* Demonstrated ownership of production systems and a bias toward automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Semiconductor experience very helpful, EDA experience a plus.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering.
* Strong hands-on experience operating and automating Kubernetes environments.
* Experience with container technologies and deployment tooling, such as Docker, Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Flux, or similar.
* Experience implementing infrastructure as code using Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, Ansible, or comparable tools.
* Practical experience with observability platforms and concepts, including metrics, logging, distributed tracing, alerting, dashboards, and SLOs.
* Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Go, Bash, or TypeScript.
* Experience with CI/CD systems and automated software delivery practices.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Linux, networking, containers, cloud or on-premise infrastructure, and distributed systems.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines.

title: DevOps Engineering Manager
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.

**Role Summary**

The Manager, DevOps Engineering is the lead hands-on engineer responsible for the India-based DevOps capability supporting enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure. The role combines technical leadership with direct engineering accountability across Azure infrastructure, networking, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, security, environment management, observability, and production readiness.

This is not a process-focused or administrative management role. The manager is expected to personally design, build, review, and troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment pipelines, network configurations, access controls, monitoring, and automation. The role will also establish engineering standards, mentor DevOps engineers, review technical work, and serve as the escalation point for complex infrastructure and deployment issues.

The manager will work closely with enterprise architects, application teams, integration engineers, data engineers, networking, security, and delivery leadership to ensure environments and deployment processes are secure, repeatable, scalable, and operationally supportable. The role is accountable for improving delivery discipline, reducing manual processes, resolving environment bottlenecks, and ensuring infrastructure and releases are ready for production.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and mentor DevOps engineers while remaining hands-on in delivery.
* Design and support Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, monitoring, and platform services.
* Manage virtual networks, subnets, private endpoints, DNS, routing, firewalls, and IP capacity.
* Build and maintain reusable Infrastructure as Code using Bicep or Terraform.
* Design and support Azure DevOps YAML pipelines and reusable deployment templates.
* Automate environment provisioning, configuration, testing, release, rollback, and recovery.
* Implement Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, service principals, RBAC, Key Vault, and least-privilege controls.
* Establish monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational runbooks.
* Review infrastructure code, pipeline code, scripts, and security changes.
* Lead troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, incident response, and production-readiness reviews.
* Enforce DevOps, security, release, and operational engineering standards.
* Partner with architecture, application, integration, data, networking, and security teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or related experience.
* 4+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure engineering experience.
* 2+ years in a lead engineer or technical management role.
* Strong Azure networking and IP-address planning experience.
* Strong Infrastructure as Code experience using Bicep, Terraform, or both.
* Strong Azure DevOps and YAML pipeline experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, managed identities, service principals, and Key Vault.
* Experience with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Strong scripting skills using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, or Python.
* Demonstrated ability to lead engineers while remaining technically hands-on.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Grid, Event Hubs, and microservices.
* Experience with D365 Finance and Operations, Power Platform, or Dataverse.
* Experience with Azure Policy, security scanning, disaster recovery, and cost optimization.
* Experience with containers, AKS, or site reliability engineering practices.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

title: Senior MLOps Consultant (Databricks)
description:
**Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer (Databricks)**

Chryselys is looking for a Senior MLOps / AI Delivery Engineer with strong experience in Databricks to run the machine learning lifecycle from experiment to production.

You will set up Databricks environments, turn notebooks into scheduled jobs, and package and deploy models with consistent runtimes, versioning, and monitoring. You will work with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, platform teams, and business stakeholders in healthcare and pharmaceutical domains.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set up and maintain Databricks for ML: workspaces, clusters, instance pools, cluster policies, Repos, and runtime versions.
* Provide notebook and job templates, shared libraries, and pinned environments so experiments can be repeated.
* Build CI/CD to promote notebooks, jobs, workflows, and models across development, staging, and production environments using Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps, with Databricks Asset Bundles or the Jobs and Repos APIs.
* Track, package, register, and deploy models with MLflow on Databricks, including batch scoring and model serving jobs.
* Build Databricks Workflows for training, retraining, evaluation, and inference, with task dependencies, retries, and alerts.
* Support classification, forecasting as Python and Spark jobs on Databricks.
* Tune cluster size, autoscaling, Spark settings, and Delta Lake reads and writes so jobs stay reliable and cost-efficient.
* Convert Data Scientist notebooks into production pipelines with clear inputs, outputs, and fixed dependencies.
* Apply Databricks controls: Unity Catalog for data and model access, secret scopes, service principals, and model versioning.
* Fix failed jobs, slow Spark runs, library conflicts, and environment differences across workspaces.
* Write standards and runbooks for workspace layout, cluster policies, job templates, and promotion from dev to production.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelors or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6–12 years in ML Engineering, MLOps, or platform engineering, including hands-on ML work on Databricks.
* Databricks experience with workspaces, clusters and policies, Jobs and Workflows, Repos, Delta Lake, and Spark (batch and streaming).
* MLflow on Databricks for experiment tracking, model packaging, and the model registry.
* Strong Python, plus working knowledge of PySpark or Spark SQL.
* CI/CD for Databricks with Git and GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.
* Experience deploying ML models on Databricks, Azure, AWS services.
* Clear debugging skills and the ability to work with data science and platform teams.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform, or workspace-as-code.
* Unity Catalog, cluster policies, and service principals for job runs.
* Azure ML services such as Azure Machine Learning and Amazon SageMaker for training, pipelines, or model deployment.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical domain experience.
* Agile or Scrum.
* Python packaging on Databricks (pip or conda, and runtime libraries).

**Good to Have:**

* SQL and PySpark for reading, joining, and transforming data on Databricks.
* Simple pipelines that ingest data, clean it, and store it in Delta Lake.
* Data quality checks and schema handling.
* Familiarity with healthcare or pharma data, such as EHR, clinical, or patient and drug datasets.
* Docker for packaging jobs and model services.
* Kubernetes and KServe for deploying and scaling models.
* Helm, Kubeflow, or Seldon for model deployment.
* MLflow, GitHub Actions, and Terraform for tracking, CI/CD, and environment setup.
* Model performance monitoring, data drift detection, alerting, and rollback for production models.

title: Site Reliability Engineer,Senior
description:
We are Progress (Nasdaq: PRGS) - the trusted provider of software that enables our customers to develop, deploy and manage responsible, AI-powered applications and experience with agility and ease.

We’re proud to have a diverse, global team where we value the individual and enrich our culture by considering varied perspectives because we believe people power progress. Join us as a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** and help us do what we do best: propelling business forward. Know more about **us**.

We’re looking for a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** (SRE) to help ensure the reliability, security, and performance of our customer-facing systems and infrastructure. This role bridges development and operations, applying engineering principles to improve system resilience and scalability.

**In this role, you will:**

* Security & Compliance: Safeguard systems against breaches and ensure compliance with PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC2, and other standards.
* Cloud Infrastructure: Build and maintain scalable, secure services in Azure, AWS, or GCP using cloud-native tools.
* Automation & System Admin: Automate routine tasks, manage backups, and configure servers for high availability and disaster recovery.
* Monitoring & Performance: Implement observability tools, optimize system performance, and proactively address issues.
* Incident Response: Participate in on-call rotations, troubleshoot service incidents, and lead postmortem reviews.
* Collaboration: Work closely with developers, QA, and support teams in agile environments.
* Customer Provisioning: Handle complex customer account setups in coordination with Sales and Professional Services.
* Infrastructure as Code: Champion IaC practices using tools like Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.

**Your background:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
* 6+ years of Proven experience in a Senior SRE or similar role in production environments.
* Strong skills in Windows/Linux, scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell), and cloud services (ECS, EKS, S3, etc.).
* Good to have hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Rancher, and container orchestration.

title: Senior Manager DevOps Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering is a hands-on engineering leader accountable for the strategy, design, delivery, and operational maturity of secure cloud platforms and software delivery capabilities supporting Claims Global Claims Operations (GCO). This leader will manage and develop a team of DevOps, platform, and site reliability engineers while partnering with application, data, AI/ML, architecture, security, and product teams.

The role will establish standardized CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud governance, observability, reliability, and DevSecOps practices that accelerate delivery while maintaining the controls required for healthcare and other regulated workloads. The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with deep technical judgment, measurable operational ownership, and the ability to influence across a complex enterprise.

Leadership mandate: Build a reliable, secure, reusable engineering platform that improves developer velocity, production resilience, and governance by design.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* People Leadership & Engineering Management
  + Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary DevOps/platform engineering team; establish clear goals, operating rhythms, career development plans, and accountability for outcomes
  + Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and skills development aligned to the platform roadmap
  + Create an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and blameless improvement
  + Translate business priorities into an executable roadmap, capacity plan, delivery milestones, and measurable engineering outcomes
* DevOps Platform Strategy & Delivery
  + Define and execute the DevOps and platform engineering strategy for cloud-native applications, data products, and AI-enabled solutions
  + Build and govern reusable "paved-road" capabilities including source control standards, build automation, artifact management, deployment pipelines, environment provisioning, configuration management, and release orchestration
  + Establish standardized CI/CD patterns for application, infrastructure, data, and AI/ML workloads, with automated quality gates and promotion controls
  + Drive platform adoption through strong documentation, self-service workflows, developer enablement, office hours, and actionable product telemetry
* Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
  + Lead the design and operation of secure, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code and policy-as-code practices
  + Establish reusable Terraform modules and cloud deployment patterns covering networking, compute, containers, serverless, storage, databases, identity, secrets, logging, and monitoring
  + Guide container orchestration and runtime engineering using Kubernetes/EKS and related cloud-native technologies where appropriate
  + Partner with architecture, cloud, security, and FinOps teams to improve cloud governance, capacity management, resilience, and cost transparency
* DevSecOps, Risk & Compliance
  + Embed security across the software delivery lifecycle, including code scanning, dependency and container scanning, secrets management, infrastructure scanning, image provenance, and release approvals
  + Implement role-based access, segregation of duties, audit evidence, traceability, and policy enforcement consistent with enterprise and regulated-environment requirements
  + Partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and audit teams to remediate findings and maintain production-readiness controls
  + Ensure platform capabilities protect sensitive healthcare data and support applicable privacy, retention, and access-control expectations
* Site Reliability & Operational Excellence
  + Define service-level objectives, reliability indicators, error budgets, operational dashboards, and production health standards for critical services
  + Advance end-to-end observability through metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, alerting, and service health telemetry
  + Lead incident response and problem management practices, including command structure, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and learning reviews
  + Drive resilience engineering through high availability, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, capacity planning, performance engineering, and game-day exercises
* AI/ML and Data Delivery Enablement
  + Enable secure delivery patterns for AI/ML and generative AI workloads, including model and prompt configuration promotion, evaluation gates, lineage, observability, rollback, and controlled release
  + Partner with data and AI engineering teams to establish MLOps, LLMOps, and DataOps integration points without duplicating domain-team ownership
  + Provide platform controls for agentic and AI-enabled solutions, including environment isolation, secrets, auditability, monitoring, kill-switch or containment mechanisms, and production support readiness
* Enterprise Collaboration & Executive Communication
  + Partner with product, application, data, AI/ML, architecture, quality engineering, operations, security, and business stakeholders to align priorities and delivery commitments
  + Lead architecture and operational-readiness reviews; communicate tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, investment needs, and progress to senior leadership
  + Manage vendor and strategic partner delivery, including scope, technical quality, capacity, performance, and knowledge transfer
  + Drive continuous improvement using engineering metrics, delivery analytics, operational trends, and stakeholder feedback
* Success Measures
  + Improved deployment frequency, lead time for change, change failure rate, and mean time to restore, measured using agreed delivery and reliability baselines
  + Increased adoption and reuse of standardized pipelines, infrastructure modules, security controls, and observability patterns
  + Reduced manual provisioning, deployment effort, configuration drift, production incidents, and repeat operational defects
  + Measurable improvement in service availability, recovery readiness, cloud cost efficiency, audit readiness, and developer experience
  + Predictable roadmap execution, effective talent development, and strong stakeholder confidence in platform delivery
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or related disciplines
* 5+ years of experience leading engineers and engineering managers or senior technical leads, including performance management, hiring, coaching, and delivery accountability
* 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating cloud solutions on AWS in enterprise environments
* Demonstrated experience establishing mature CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, DevSecOps, observability, and release-management capabilities at scale
* Solid experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or comparable CI/CD platforms; Terraform or comparable Infrastructure-as-Code tooling; and modern artifact and source-control practices
* Experience with containers and cloud-native platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes/EKS, plus production operations for distributed systems
* Experience leading production operations, incident management, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and reliability improvement programs
* Solid understanding of cloud security, identity and access management, secrets management, vulnerability management, policy enforcement, and audit controls
* Working proficiency in one or more automation languages such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash
* Proven ability to communicate technical strategy, delivery status, operational risk, and investment tradeoffs clearly to technical and executive audiences

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect/DevOps Engineer, Kubernetes, Terraform, ITIL, or security certifications
* Experience supporting healthcare claims, financial, or other regulated and high-availability technology environments
* Experience building internal developer platforms, reusable cloud foundations, golden paths, or platform-as-a-product capabilities
* Experience with AWS services such as IAM, VPC, EKS, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudWatch, RDS, DynamoDB, KMS, Secrets Manager, and related governance services
* Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, or comparable tools
* Experience with software supply-chain security, SBOMs, artifact signing, SAST/DAST/SCA, container security, and policy-as-code
* Proven exposure to data platform delivery, event streaming, Kafka, MLOps, LLMOps, RAG, generative AI, or agentic AI production patterns
* Core Leadership & Technical Competencies
* People Leadership - Team building, coaching, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and inclusive leadership
* Platform Engineering - Internal developer platforms, reusable delivery patterns, self-service automation, platform adoption, and product thinking
* CI/CD & Release Engineering - GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, artifact management, test integration, quality gates, progressive delivery, and rollback
* Cloud & Infrastructure - AWS architecture, Terraform, containers, Kubernetes/EKS, serverless, networking, IAM, resilience, and cost optimization
* DevSecOps - Secure SDLC, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets, vulnerability management, policy-as-code, auditability, and software supply-chain controls
* SRE & Observability - SLIs/SLOs, logging, metrics, tracing, alerting, incident management, capacity, availability, disaster recovery, and performance
* Automation & Engineering - Python/Go/PowerShell/Bash, APIs, configuration management, testing, design standards, and engineering quality
* AI/Data Enablement - DataOps, MLOps/LLMOps integration, AI release controls, lineage, evaluation, runtime monitoring, and containment patterns
* Execution & Influence - Roadmap ownership, prioritization, dependency management, vendor leadership, executive communication, and cross-functional influence
